required_outcomes: Finds the washing machine update in point 3 and treats it as the tenant's self-resolution: their own machine installed and tested with no leaks, the landlord's machine in the garage, no visit wanted.
Tells the landlord, who has just agreed to a visit, that the tenant has swapped in their own machine and no contractor is being sent, and asks what he wants done with his machine.
Closes the washing machine request without payment, or holds it briefly for the landlord's answer, with no contractor assigned.
Replies to the tenant on the washing machine and gives a short, accurate answer or route for the other points, without inventing dates or facts the case does not contain.
acceptable_alternatives: Handling the gas safety question by a dated follow-up or note to look up the record and send the tenant a copy, rather than answering it in this run.
Leaving the bins and parking points with a one-line pointer to the council.
positive_behaviours: Notes the tenant is entitled to a copy of the current gas safety record and offers to send it.
Routes the communal landing light to whoever manages the building's common parts rather than raising a repair on the flat.
Records that the machine in use belongs to the tenant.
red_flags: Missing the washing machine update and booking the visit the landlord just agreed to.
Opening new repair jobs or escalations for the bins, parking or communal light.
prohibited_actions: Assigning a maintenance provider or booking a visit for the washing machine.
Stating a gas safety due date that is not in the case.
critical_failures: Closing the washing machine request with the landlord uninformed of the tenant's self-resolution.
